title: AlexNet

paper.title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement AlexNet: adapt convolution ReLU pooling and dropout to CIFAR-10; aspirational accuracy 0.85 within 300 seconds. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use cifar10; required output: [N,3,32,32] -> [N,10] logits. Evaluate accuracy (maximize). CIFAR adaptation not ImageNet reproduction. Required ablation: Remove dropout while preserving the training schedule. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.

dataset.name: cifar10
dataset.split_policy: Disjoint train/validation/test examples; fit preprocessing using training data only.

budget.note: Provisional safety caps, not empirically calibrated GPU budgets.

metric.name: accuracy
metric.target_status: provisional draft targets only; threshold remains null until calibration
metric.goal_status: aspirational user-specified goal; not a calibrated pass threshold

interface.data: dict with train and val torch.utils.data.TensorDataset entries

checks: Return a Submission containing a torch module.
Do not read validation labels during fitting.
No NaN or infinite outputs; obey parameter cap.

ablation.change: Remove dropout while preserving the training schedule
ablation.control: Same split, seed, training steps and optimizer.
ablation.report: Report metric and parameter/time deltas honestly; do not infer superiority from one seed.

hints: adapt convolution ReLU pooling and dropout to CIFAR-10; aspirational accuracy 0.85 within 300 seconds

Start with the smallest deterministic fixture and compare with a trusted primitive.

calibration.note: No GPU calibration performed; no passing threshold advertised.
